description: Animate MANY images into videos in ONE call (max 25 jobs). Prefer this over looping lab_animate: it validates every job BEFORE spending any quota, so an invalid job 12 of 15 does not leave 11 paid-for generations running. Quota is spent once, collectively (one ledger row); refunds stay per-clip, so a partial failure refunds only that clip. Returns a batch_id — poll lab_batch_status with it instead of polling each id separately. `get_cost: true` preflights the whole batch without generating anything.

get_cost.description: Preflight: return the summed price in credits for the WHOLE batch and your balance WITHOUT generating, reading the same catalog as lab_list_models. For a card the user confirms, use lab_propose instead.

jobs.description: One entry per clip, max 25. All jobs are validated before any quota is spent

abdruck_startframe.description: Frame one from the character's trained Abdruck for THIS clip — see lab_animate for the full rule

apply_lens.description: Defaults to TRUE on the backend (project lens_state is appended). Pass false to opt out for this clip only

audio_url.description: URL of an existing audio track to lay under THIS clip. Independent of generate_audio

camera_motion.description: Camera move for THIS clip — see lab_animate

character_refs.description: Character ids (positive integer strings) locking the cast's identity for THIS clip

character_states.description: State key per character for THIS clip, { characterId: stateKey } — the ONLY way a state descriptor reaches the generation; the reference image always carries the base state

character_voices.description: Voice per character for THIS clip (kling_3_pro only) — see lab_animate

duration_seconds.description: Clip length in seconds for THIS clip — must lie inside the model's duration grid from lab_list_models. Ignored when shots is given — see lab_animate

end_image_id.description: Last frame for THIS clip — only models with supports_end_frame (lab_list_models). Needs a start frame — see lab_animate

generate_audio.description: Ask for the model's native audio track for THIS clip — only meaningful where lab_list_models says audio: schaltbar, see lab_animate for the full rule

intent.description: Route by intent instead of naming a model: 'draft'|'ambient' (cheapest), 'dialog', 'hero', 'atmo'. An explicit tool wins over intent

kamerapfad.description: Camera path for THIS clip (object following shared/kamerapfad/schema.json) — never as poses, but in the form this clip's model understands (prose, or director commands for MiniMax/Hailuo); the answer names the form as kamerapfad.angewandt. See lab_animate

kamerapfad_url.description: Address of a kamerapfad JSON in this project for THIS clip — see lab_animate. Mutually exclusive with kamerapfad

location_id.description: Location board id for THIS clip (from lab_list_locations) — its `prompt_prefix_en` is appended to this job's prompt

metadata.description: Free-form JSON stored alongside this clip. Not interpreted by the pipeline

resolution.description: Resolution tier for THIS clip, exactly as listed in lab_list_models. Omit for the model's default — see lab_animate

scene_ref.description: Optional scene label, useful to match results back to a shot list

seed.description: Seed for THIS clip — see lab_animate for the full rule

shot_type.description: Cutting mode for THIS clip's shots — see lab_animate

shots.description: Multi-shot for THIS clip (kling_3_pro only). The billed length is the SUM of the shot durations, NOT duration_seconds — see lab_animate

source_image_id.description: id of a completed image to animate — positive integer as string. Omit for text-to-video

tool.description: Video model id for THIS clip — copy it verbatim from lab_list_models (kind: video); providers can differ per job. Omit to let the intent router choose — see lab_animate

ohne_keyframe.description: Skip the keyframe checkpoint on purpose. By default a paid clip only starts from a start image the user has approved (lab_review_asset verdict: accepted) — look at the frame first, then spend on the clip. Set true only when the user explicitly asked to skip the frame check.
